headline: On November 1, 1982: Honda opens its first US factory
captionCards: First car produced: a Honda Accord
Marked a new era of global auto production
instagramCaption:
Honda makes history in Marysville, Ohio. \\[A new chapter for Honda and the US auto industry began on November 1, 1982, when Honda opened its first manufacturing plant in Marysville, Ohio. The first car to roll off the production line was a Honda Accord. This move marked Honda as the first Asian automaker to produce cars in the United States. Today, this milestone is a testament to global economic integration and the impact of foreign investment. \\What do you think was the most significant outcome of Honda's decision? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
